content: 用户偏好：回答和文档都使用简体中文，代码注释用英文
git push 之前先运行 pre-commit hooks；不要用 --no-verify 跳过检查
Python projects should use uv for dependency management (uv add / uv sync), never pip install directly
When a test is flaky, rerun it in isolation with -p no:randomly before changing code
本机的 Docker 使用 colima，启动命令是 colima start --cpu 4 --memory 8
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:
用 sed -i 时 macOS 需要写成 sed -i ''，否则会报 invalid command code
The user's GitHub handle is lpz and PRs should target the main branch
Weekly team sync is on Tuesday 10:00 Beijing time
服务器 SSH 统一走跳板机 bastion.internal，端口 2222
部署 payments-svc 之前必须先执行数据库迁移 (make migrate)，否则订单表会缺字段导致 500
payments-svc 金额一律用 Decimal 存储，保留两位小数，舍入用 ROUND_HALF_UP
The staging database for payments-svc is read-only on Fridays; schedule migrations for Thursday
Stripe webhook 签名校验失败时，先检查是否用了 raw body；JSON 解析后的 body 会导致签名不匹配
payments-svc integration tests need the STRIPE_TEST_KEY env var and a running local Postgres on port 5433
Refund flow: create refund record, call Stripe refunds API with an idempotency key, mark the ledger entry reversed, emit refund.completed
对账任务每天凌晨 2 点运行，重复导出的记录按 (source, external_id) 去重
Error 'psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation: duplicate key value violates unique constraint ledger_pkey' means the reconcile job ran twice; check the cron lock before retrying
atlas-web uses pnpm, not npm or yarn; CI runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
atlas-web 的组件样式统一用 Tailwind，禁止新增 CSS Modules 文件
Next.js hydration mismatch in atlas-web usually comes from Date.now() or locale formatting during SSR; move it into useEffect
atlas-web 的 API 基址在 .env.local 的 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE 配置，本地默认 http://localhost:8080
Adding a page in atlas-web: create app/<route>/page.tsx, register it in nav.config.ts, add an e2e test under tests/e2e
Playwright 测试在 CI 上超时通常是没装浏览器，需要先执行 pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps
atlas-web 的界面文案放在 locales/zh-CN.json 和 locales/en.json，新增文案两个文件都要加
Design system colors live in tailwind.config.ts under theme.extend.colors; never hardcode hex values in components
ctx 的记忆以 Markdown 文件为真相源，存放在 ~/.ctx/memory，SQLite 索引可随时重建
修改 ctx 的 Rust 代码后要跑 cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings，CI 把警告当错误
ctx proxy listens only on 127.0.0.1:7788 and every API call needs the X-Ctx-Token header
OpenClaw 通过 ctx 代理时 provider 要用 api: openai-completions，否则请求路径不对
The gateway reports model gemini-3.8-flash even when gemini-3.8-flash-high is requested
发布 ctx 新版本：改 Cargo.toml 版本号，cargo build --release，复制到 ~/.ctx/bin/ctx，再用 launchctl kickstart 重启服务
